}}'''Ihvon''' is [[Warder]] to [[Alanna Mosvani]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ihvon}}

== Appearance ==
He is tall and slender and of a dark complexion.

== Activities ==
He is present in the Two Rivers when [[Perrin Aybara]] comes back to confront the [[Children of the Light]].{{ref/book|4|30}} He saves Perrin's life by killing a [[Myrddraal]] that was about to kill Perrin during the Waterwood ambush.{{ref/book|4|40}} He was told to bring Perrin back to Alanna. He helps the village when the [[Shadowspawn]] army attacks.{{ref/book|4|56}}

He goes with Alanna to [[Far Madding]] to find [[Rand al'Thor]].{{ref/book|9|23}}

His fate after Alanna's kidnapping{{ref/book|13|12}} and death{{ref/book|14|46}} is unknown, but due to the silence from him, it can be presumed he was killed in her disappearance.

== In the television series ==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Ihvon}} is played by actor {{TVlink|Emmanuel Imani}}.
